title: Earlier at Cinderhall, Ness set up an alternate hold-grief resolution ('back the hall's claim (Free Companies)') tied to a later choice at the Hundred Gallery, but once 'speak the truth over the Hundred' was chosen instead, returning to Ness produced no acknowledgment that her thread was now moot - she just repeats her stock line.
